newsitem.title: USA: Fort Howard added to NASDAQ-100 Index.
newsitem.headline: Fort Howard added to NASDAQ-100 Index.

text.p: Fort Howard Corp said Wednesday its common shares have been added to the list of issues that make up the National Association of Securities Dealer's NASDAQ-100 Index.
Fort Howard said it was among 14 isssues added to ensure the index represents the largest and most active non-financial domestic stocks on the NASDAQ Stock Market.
To qualify, a company's shares must have a market value of $500 million and an average daily volume of 100,000 shares.
Fort Howard is a maker of consumer paper products.
The company's shares closed down 7/16 Wednesday at 28-7/8.
